items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: He played with the Tuxedo Band years ago. What, Celestan's Tuxedo Band? Celestan's Baby Ridgely.

ctx.x: Do you remember what he played like? Was he a good drummer?
He was not a good drummer. He played with the Tuxedo Band years ago. What, Celestan's Tuxedo Band? Celestan's Baby Ridgely.
